thread:
Maria Nguyen: Quick ask — we need to open cloud quota requests for a new Q4 dedicated GPU pool in eu-north-1. Planning baseline + burst capacity for a launch spike. Can someone own assembling the support ticket and cross-account permissions?
Zheng Li: What numbers are you thinking for baseline vs burst? and which GPU families (A10G/A100)?
Maria Nguyen: Baseline: 40 x A10G (steady state for customer-facing inference). Burst: up to 120 x A10G for 4–6 hours during launch windows (3 consecutive days). Fallback pool: 8 x A100-80GB reserved for heavy multimodal jobs.
Maria Nguyen: Also need networking limits bumped: 600 EIPs for nat/bastion + ENI quota increase for instance density, and a subnet /24 expansion request for the dedicated VPC peering range.
Tim Anders: Also add per-region vCPU and instance quota increases — some providers peg GPUs to instance-family vCPU quotas. Which account will host the Dedicated pools?
Maria Nguyen: Dedicated pools live in account: rw-inference-dedicated-eu (account-id: 820-774-331). We're doing cross-account peering to prod-controlplane in rw-core (account-id: 820-774-110). I'll attach the IAM role ARNs in the ticket.
Sasha Patel: I'll draft the support payload. Copying the minimal template we use for quota asks — make sure to include exact instance types and SKU names. Example payload we should paste into the provider support form:
```
{
  "account": "820774331",
  "region": "eu-north-1",
  "requests": [
    {"quota": "GPU_A10G_instances", "current": "12", "desired": "140", "justification": "Baseline 40 + burst 120 for Q4 product launch, sustained 4-6h windows"},
    {"quota": "GPU_A100_80GB_instances", "current": "0", "desired": "8", "justification": "Fallback heavy workloads and safety capacity"},
    {"quota": "EIP", "current": "50", "desired": "600", "justification": "Dedicated NAT/bastion pools for isolated VPCs"},
    {"quota": "ENI", "current": "2000", "desired": "5000", "justification": "Increased pod/instance density planned for dedicated cluster"},
    {"quota": "VCPU", "current": "4000", "desired": "6000", "justification": "Family-coupled instances for GPU hosts"}
  ],
  "timeline": "Need approvals and quotas in place by 2024-10-10",
  "contact": "maria@redwood.ai, zheng@redwood.ai",
  "cost_center": "INFRA-DED-Q4"
}
```
Sasha Patel: If you confirm numbers I'll submit and tag cloud-accounts. Also include a request for a temporary emergency burst increase (short window) in case launch spikes exceed expected headroom.
cloud-accounts-bot: Ticket draft saved to internal tracker (draft-9834). Please review before submission.
Finance Ops: Heads-up — for anything that pushes sustained GPU spend beyond the current forecast we'll need a monthly run-rate estimate. Can you add expected hours and utilization?
Maria Nguyen: Rough cost calc: A10G rented baseline 720h/month * 40 units + burst 6h * 80 extra units during launch days (~3 days). At our committed discount, ballpark monthly delta ~ $85k–$120k. Fallback A100 run cost estimate adds another $30k if used heavily. I'll produce a tighter estimate in the request.
Zheng Li: For the support form put a line about autoscaling policy: baseline nodes pinned to a reserved pool, burst served from a warm pool that spins up new instances via dedicated account role. That helps justify the short-term burst ask.
Tim Anders: Also confirm if we need public IPs on the hosts or we can use NAT gateway architecture — EIPs are expensive and sometimes we can avoid them with private endpoints + proxy.
Maria Nguyen: We need some EIPs for customer ingress and for debugging bastion host access. We can minimize but not eliminate. I'll note that in the justification.
Sasha Patel: Submitted ticket to provider support as case #CS-47211 (attached draft id=9834). Included the cost_center and asked for escalation path with phone contact.
ops-bot: Automated update — provider case CS-47211 created, severity: normal, expected first response within 48 hours.
cloud-accounts-bot: Please attach the cross-account IAM policy allowing rw-core to assume role rw-dedicated-deploy@820774331. Also confirm whether we want roles shared with partner accounts.
Maria Nguyen: IAM policy attached in thread. We don't want partner access for now — only rw-core and ops CI.
Finance Ops: Thanks — can you update the monthly delta in the case comments when you have the finalized numbers? Approvals for >$100k/month need director sign-off.
Zheng Li: I'll run a dry-run scale in staging on 2024-09-25 to validate instance spin-up times and subnet limits. If we hit ENI or IP limits in staging I'll escalate earlier.
Maria Nguyen: Great — owners: Sasha to manage case submission/updates, Zheng to do staging validation, Tim to confirm network design and EIP minimization, Finance Ops to clear cost thresholds.
Sasha Patel: I'll post updates to this thread as soon as provider responds or we hit blockers. :thumbsup:
Maria Nguyen: Thanks everyone — timeline still target 2024-10-10 for quota in place. If provider needs more justification ping me and I'll add traffic/load tests and eval traces.
